item.title: Long Chen
item.description:
I am currently an undergraduate student at Chongqing University and will join Zhejiang University as a Ph.D. student in Fall 2027. My research interests lie in robotics and embodied intelligence, particularly learning-based robot decision-making and control in complex, unstructured environments.
